mapper.sql: p.id, p.tenant_id, p.application_id, p.process_code, p.process_name, p.process_description, p.subject_object_id, p.subject_object_code, p.draft_schema_json, p.draft_schema_hash, p.design_status, p.current_version, p.published_version, p.status, p.legacy_source_type, p.legacy_source_id, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.create_dept, p.update_by, p.update_time

INNER JOIN ai_business_application a ON a.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND a.id = p.application_id AND a.status = 1 AND a.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ai_business_application_object ao ON ao.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND ao.application_id = p.application_id AND ao.object_id = p.subject_object_id AND ao.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND o.id = p.subject_object_id AND o.object_code = p.subject_object_code AND o.status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_process SET del_flag = id, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
